verdict.rationale: Cekura documents one framework-level tracing integration: an SDK that adds observability to LiveKit voice agents. Its other integrations (Retell, VAPI) pull call data from hosted platforms rather than instrument app code, and none of the named frameworks are covered. Missing for 10: integrations for LangChain, the OpenAI SDK or the Vercel AI SDK, depth of the LiveKit tracing docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK
